profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Lucid Motors, I am passionate about building large scale customer facing UI using React, Nextjs, and Java. I have 6+ years of experience in all stages of web development, from design to deployment, and I constantly challenge myself to innovate and build highly performant and secure web apps.

I have a Master's degree in Computer Science from California State University-Fullerton, where I gained a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles. I have also acquired multiple certifications in ethical hacking, responsive layouts, and flexbox, demonstrating my commitment to learning and improving my skills. I have a knack for designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions for complex technical issues, and I have experience in mentoring a high performance team of engineers and testers. I enjoy collaborating and partnering with various stakeholders, such as PM, EM, QA, and other engineering teams, to deliver critical features and products that meet user needs and business goals.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Promoted to Senior Full Stack Engineer, overseeing full-stack ownership across AI tooling, enterprise SSO, and dealer service workflows.  
• Founded and built the Partner Portal from the ground up using React 18 and TypeScript, ensuring robust feature delivery.  
• Developed a standalone Auth0 package for AUCTUS, enhancing security with RBAC utilities and session persistence.  
• Awarded the Lifting Lucid Award for exceptional contributions and dedication to project success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
UI Component Libraries — 2 Libraries Authored
• Architected @lucid/lego — atomic design system with 55+ components: 36 atoms (Grid, Typography, DatePicker, FileUpload, PhoneInput, Toast, VideoPlayer & more), 8 molecules (Modal, Table, Carousel, Accordion, Tabs), 7 organisms (Form engine, Layout, Sidebar, Charts, Navigation)
• Built a comprehensive Forms Library from scratch — 15+ field types, field dependency resolution, pristine-snapshot dirty tracking, and invisible reCAPTCHA integration
• Pioneered CMS-driven floating components — first-of-its-kind Contentful-managed popovers and modals, adopted across multiple frontend teams

Consumer Website — Gatsby → Astro → Next.js Migration
• Led the full framework migration of lucidmotors.com across three generations: Gatsby (SSG) → Astro (island architecture) → Next.js (App Router), each driven by performance and scalability needs
• Rebuilt the Locations & Charging page with a custom MapProvider (React Context API), geolocation API, real-time filter state, and multi-country coverage
• Owned the Compare page — CPQ pricing integration, incentives API, Air vs Gravity spec comparison, and DreamDrive specs across locales
• Built the Configurator — ZeroLight WebGL integration, CMF paint/color preview API, shortcode-based configuration, and RenderChain image generation
• Delivered Careers, Gravity, Air Sapphire, Road to Gravity, Offers, and Media Room pages
• Led complete Demo Drive redesign — responsive frontend, backend API integration, and Contentful CMS-driven content
• Boosted Lighthouse scores from low-70s to mid-90s via lazy loading, WebP compression, and code-splitting

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Resolved critical issues including P0 security issue leaking user credentials
through SSRF vulnerability
• Built extensible and configurable forms library that allowed rendering forms
through json configurations
• Key Contributor for Admin Config UI Framework which enabled to deliver most re-
cent updates to customers within minutes outside of the splunk’s quarterly release
cadence
• Integrated with various toolkits that enabled writing effective functional and inte-
gration tests for UI/UX components as well as improving overall code coverage
• Closely Collaborated and partnered with PM, EM, QA and multiple engineering
teams to deliver Splunk’s critical features including Splunk’s Webhook Allow List
feature
• Regularly demonstrated multiple key features to the entire organization including
senior leadership and engineering teams
• Provided detailed documentation for key front end components and migration
strategies
• Conducted effective interviews for senior engineers as well as interns

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Revamping existing Apartment Ratings site using Nextjs and Typescript
• Developed new API’s for company statistics, improving performance of existing
API’s using Java Spring boot
• Writing complex SQL queries on production data to help Account Managers
• Created universal styled-components(table, bar chart, forms, buttons) and Story
Book for revamping the web application
• Designed and developed a company management portal using React Hooks and
Java Spring boot
• Worked closely with the product team to design and develop threaded review system
for users to share their reviews and stories
• Created grades badges for communities and companies to display average scores

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on the front end tool using React, ContextAPI and React Hooks for displaying
the page view and cookie counts to build segments for ads purpose
• Created communities result page for ApartmentRatings.com using React and Redux
by first validating the user’s city and state name input and then displaying the
community results to the user
• Improved the performance (page rendering) of the Carsdirect page by 40% by
asynchronizing scripts, minifying and compressing JS and CSS files. Combined JS
files to reduce the number of calls made to those files from a webpage, loading low
resolution images and switching them with high resolution images after the page
loads
• Developed a tool page using React, Redux, and React router for ApartmentRatings
where the user with the moderator role can add new cities to his account
• Worked on a health theme template (home, category, and article pages) using
HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, and PHP which is implemented across 14 Health Sites

positions.title: Associate Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Re-factored the existing Javascript code by implementing Singleton Javascript pattern
and replacing Ajax calls with Async Await and JS promises
• Created a function using Javascript which injected ads within the articles body and
also displayed/removed an ad based on its visibility on the page. It is implemented
across all the health sites, carsdirect, Justmommies, doityourself
• Implemented infinite scrolling based pagination using Javascript and PHP to load
next set of related contents when the user reached the end of a page
• Worked on page speed optimization and performance issues using Google Page
Speed (API) for Apache to obtain higher rankings on Search Engines (SEM)
• Participated in code-reviews, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and bug squashing
sessions
• Collaborated closely with Back-End, UI and Product teams to establish reliable
requirements to achieve the business goals

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Maintained and updated HTML5/CSS3 templates on a regular basis and updated
layouts of the website as required
• Hosted website on AWS server with the help of Amazon EC2 instance and then
associating the domain name with the help Amazon Route 53

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Maintained client websites on an ongoing basis including assistance in monitoring
and reporting website traffic, performance, and testing (A/B Split Testing and unit
testing)
• Provided internet related services including website design, front-end web development,
domain name registration, web hosting, search engine optimization/ submission
• Executed and contributed to full-stack web development projects, with an emphasis
on front-end features, browser manipulation, and cross-browser compatibility

projects.title: YouTube Viewer
projects.description:
•	Created the above web presence similar to YouTube. Using YouTube api search package to retrieve user’s query 
•	Learnt a new technique to fetch the data(axios), enhancing react skill set, and implementing ES6

projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.description:
•	Developed the above Web presence from the ground-up – from concept, navigation, layout and programming to UX and SEO (Technologies used: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JQuery)
•	Designed Photoshop layout followed by converting it to web pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
•	Implemented Google maps API
•	Created and implemented a custom CSS grid system, with CSS media queries for mobile responsiveness
•	UX tests to test the usability of mobile or websites
•	Created a progress bar using JavaScript, showing progress on the page 
•	Implemented JQuery method animate() for smooth scrolling within the page
•	Used CSS3 transitions to change property values smoothly (from one value to another), over a given duration
